entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these ridiculous cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with them. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is 78-whatever. Look, I don't have time for this. These shoes are junk and I want my money back.
Okay, Mr. Jones, I'm pulling that up now. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

They're defective! They're torture devices! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times and all I get are massive blisters on my heels. They're unusable. If you don't give me a refund, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Is that clear enough?
I understand your frustration, and I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters. That sounds incredibly painful. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
You better. Your website says 10 days. I've had them for about two and a half months. Don't try to tell me I'm out of luck. I want a manager right now if you're going to give me any trouble.

There's no need for that, sir. I'm checking the purchase date now... and yes, I see the order was delivered 72 days ago. You are correct, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for this item.
So you're processing the refund or not? Stop wasting my time.

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for a full refund right now. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file as we speak. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Fine. Make sure it's a full refund. No funny business with restocking fees.
I can confirm it will be a full refund with no fees. The email has just been sent. Will there be anything else for you today, Mr. Jones?
No. Just get me my money.
